name: How does foreclosed property interior repair usually work from start to finish?
description: It typically goes walkthrough, estimate, cleanup, repairs, then final documentation. The exact steps depend on how damaged, dirty, or stripped the interior is.

mainEntity.name: How does foreclosed property interior repair usually work from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually starts with a walkthrough, then a scope estimate, then cleanup, repair, and final documentation. Depending on the condition, that can include debris removal, odor control, drywall or flooring replacement, fixture repairs, and a final broom-clean finish.
